description: This file defines the S3Client class used for interacting with Amazon S3 services in the AWS SDK for PHP. It implements methods for bucket and object operations, middleware setup, and configuration management specific to S3 functionalities.

classes.name: S3Client
classes.description: Client used to interact with Amazon S3, providing methods for bucket and object operations, middleware configuration, and region/endpoints handling.

methods.name: createPresignedRequest
methods.description: Generates a pre-signed URL request for an S3 command with specified expiration.

methods.name: getObjectUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to an S3 object given its bucket and key.

methods.name: encodeKey
methods.description: URL encodes a key, allowing '/' characters.

methods.name: isBucketDnsCompatible
methods.description: Checks if a bucket name is DNS compatible for use as a subdomain.

methods.name: _apply_use_arn_region
methods.description: Configures client to use ARN region based on provided value.

methods.name: getLocationConstraintMiddleware
methods.description: Middleware for handling LocationConstraint during bucket creation.

methods.name: getSaveAsParameter
methods.description: Middleware supporting 'SaveAs' parameter to save object data to a file.

methods.name: getHeadObjectMiddleware
methods.description: Middleware that disables content decoding for HeadObject commands.

methods.name: getEncodingTypeMiddleware
methods.description: Middleware that auto-sets EncodingType for ListObjects commands.

methods.name: getEmptyPathWithQuery
methods.description: Middleware that handles empty request paths with query strings.

methods.name: getDisableExpressSessionAuthMiddleware
methods.description: Middleware to disable express session authentication logic.

methods.name: getSigningName
methods.description: Determines signing service name, especially for s3-object-lambda.

methods.name: _default_disable_express_session_auth
methods.description: Default resolver for disabling express session auth.

methods.name: _default_s3_express_identity_provider
methods.description: Default provider for generating S3 Express identities.

methods.name: processModel
methods.description: Handles modifications to the API model for endpoint and shape configurations based on client settings.

methods.name: addBuiltIns
methods.description: Injects region-specific client default configurations.

methods.name: isDirectoryBucket
methods.description: Checks if a bucket name matches the directory bucket naming pattern.

methods.name: _applyRetryConfig
methods.description: Applies retry configuration middleware based on provided settings.

methods.name: _applyApiProvider
methods.description: Configures the API provider and adds result mutators.

methods.name: applyDocFilters
methods.description: Augments API documentation with notes and parameter details.

methods.name: addDocExamples
methods.description: Adds example snippets to documentation for specific operations.

methods.name: getSignatureVersionFromCommand
methods.description: Returns the signature version used for signing a command.
